claim: The bounded human-capper mode can now START its worker. Nothing about its inertness changes: the target is still killed, still registry-disabled, and the delivery posture flag is still false.
note: Increment 2. Unlike increment 1, this was measured against the RUNNING production system at 616994604292345b9e44cfd0c91339fcbe9bcdef, not against branch code: the defect was found by a failed production promote (run 35278517112) and the containment values below are read-only production reads taken during and after it. The fix itself is proven by two inverted mutation controls rather than by a deploy, because deploying it is a separate reserved decision.

delivery_posture.registry_disabled_reason: Human capper official picks delivery is not activated
delivery_posture.kill_switch_contract: DeliveryKillSwitchRepository.isKilled() returns true for an unknown target

destination_routing.resolved_where: server-side, in the release transaction, before any outbox write
destination_routing.why_target_unchanged: parseGovernedTargetFromDeliveryTarget returns null for a raw discord:<channelId> target, which would skip the registry check and make the kill switch key on the channel id. The governed target is kept and the per-capper channel is pinned in the payload instead -- the same shape discord:game-threads already uses.
destination_routing.discussion_channel_refusal: picks-channel-is-discussion-channel, raised inside readCapperDiscordRouting before either id is returned
destination_routing.missing_mapping_behaviour: refuse; 0 outbox rows; pick stays validated; NOT parked in awaiting_approval
destination_routing.absent_capper_reader_behaviour: refuse (capper-routing-unavailable) -- an unprovable destination delivers nowhere
destination_routing.worker_refusal_without_pin: Human capper delivery for outbox <id> carries no pinned destination; refusing to fall back to a shared channel mapping.

recovery_door.note: not the canonical human capper path; reachable only for a pick an operator deliberately parked

human_capper_delivery.refused_posture: delivery-refused; pick stays validated; NOT parked in awaiting_approval

mutation_controls.control: createWorkerRuntimeDependencies starts a human delivery target with no shared channel mapping
createWorkerRuntimeDependencies still refuses a non-human target with no channel mapping
mutation_controls.mutation: widen the exemption to every governed target

containment.measured_against: production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm and the running containers, read-only

known_residue.observation: The scoring lane stamps picks.promotion_target on a human capper pick at submission time, for a pick no model was asked to score.
known_residue.why_safe: HUMAN_DELIVERY_TARGET_EXCLUSIVITY_GUARD refuses delivery of an authorized human pick to any board target, so the value cannot be acted on. Repairing the write itself means changing promotion persistence, which is outside this lane's scope.

activation_sequence_remaining: merge this increment (PM: pm-verdict/v1 APPROVED + t1-approved)
release the official-picks kill switch (reserved: Griff; the single remaining control capable of member delivery)

defect_repaired.symptom: worker container in Restarting (1); RuntimeConfigError RUNTIME_REQUIRED_ENV_MISSING at apps/worker/src/runtime.ts:284
defect_repaired.mechanism: deploy.yml:612/1411 refuse UNIT_TALK_DISCORD_TARGET_MAP containing discord:official-picks; assertDiscordTargetMapCoversTargets refused its absence. No value of the secret satisfied both.
defect_repaired.why_the_assertion_was_wrong: delivery-adapters.ts WORKER_PINNED_DESTINATION_GUARD resolves a human delivery target from the per-capper pin on the outbox row and refuses rather than falling back to the shared map, so the assertion demanded a mapping the delivery path never reads.
defect_repaired.fix: exempt human delivery targets via the canonical isHumanDeliveryTarget predicate; the deploy-time refusal is unchanged.
defect_repaired.escape_hatch_note: parked mode starts only because its target discord:1296531122234327100 matches ^discord:\d+$; discord:official-picks has no such form.
